## Change

Describe the user-visible behavior and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes
- [ ] Simulation workflow was exercised when relevant
- [ ] Generated G-code changes include boundary/safety tests
- [ ] Hardware behavior is marked unverified unless measured on the named controller
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated

## Safety impact

Explain whether this changes camera capture, coordinates, motion, controller communication, laser state, power scaling, or emergency behavior. “None” is acceptable only when accurate.
